name: HSL
description: Cylindrical remapping of sRGB. Hue is an angle (0–360°), Saturation and Lightness are normalized. Not perceptually uniform — equal hue steps look very unequal in brightness.

S.name: Saturation
S.notes: 0 = gray, 1 = fully saturated at given lightness

harmony_algebra.description: Harmony operations are angle arithmetic on H, mod 360
harmony_algebra.note: All operations are mod 360. Results are HSL hues — convert to sRGB for display.

known_issues: Yellow (60°) appears much brighter than blue (240°) at same S and L
Interpolation goes through unsaturated middle (hue wraps)
Not suitable for perceptual color design — use OKLab/OKLCh instead
S is context-dependent (achromatic colors have undefined H)
